scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.check:local: npm run check:types && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:types: npm run build:shared && cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint -- --max-warnings 0 && npm run build -- --no-lint
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && npm run build && npm run test -- --run
